decision: Jira integration uses the Jira REST API (read-only) via POST /rest/api/3/search/jql, runs as a standalone Node.js script, and uses the Jira issue key (e.g. PROJ-123) as the external ID for idempotent upsert into the WorkItems table.
key_insight: Jira integration uses the Jira REST API (read-only) via POST /rest/api/3/search/jql, runs as a standalone Node.js script, and uses the Jira issue key (e.g. PROJ-123) as the external ID for idempotent upsert into the WorkItems table.
alternatives_considered: Use gh CLI for Jira like GitHub integration
rejected_reason: No gh CLI equivalent for Jira; direct HTTPS is cleaner with no external CLI dependency; GET /rest/api/3/search was removed by Atlassian per changelog CHANGE-2046.
CSV export requires manual steps and breaks the automated sync workflow.
_evolve_reason: Both entries concern the Jira integration sync features and describe overlapping functionality. Consolidation removes duplication and provides a more complete and concise view.
